is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-e) (page 1, Abstract; page 3, Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts for 52 specimens using both DNA sequencing and hydrolysis probe analysis.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study comparing two molecular techniques on field-collected samples.

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo (page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Samples were collected in April 2009 (page 2, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper mentions a separate study (Koekemoer et al., submitted) that analyzed 343 specimens from the same area, but this paper reports on a specific subset of 52 specimens collected in April 2009.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts, are provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study compared DNA sequencing and hydrolysis probe analysis (TaqMan) for detecting kdr-e (L995S) and kdr-w (L995F) mutations in 52 field-collected Anopheles gambiae specimens from Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo. It found that both mutations were present and that hydrolysis probe analysis required adjustment of allelic discrimination axes to match sequencing results.
